population: Illustrative manifest extension only; Scots pine generation unsupported

seed_audit.limitations: Local audit only. Existing oak/spruce seeds are historical regressions; legacy holdout roles preserved for byte-identical cases, not claimed fresh. New pine seeds never generated; re-audit concurrent reservations before any future evaluation.

capture_method.adaptation: Benchmark-only neutral rig; reuse offline Halton integration, no dependency on unfinished optimized renderer. Actual capture tool identity and binary hashes belong to each run.

render.material: neutral clay; hemisphere illumination; no textures, ground, shadows, wind, extra subjects or LOD
render.coverage: foliage-only white on black, linear MSAA fraction; wood hidden only for coverage; beauty retains connected original wood/foliage
render.integration: float64 arithmetic sum of linear samples; divide at 64/128; persist float32 little-endian arrays and PNG previews
render.resource_policy: No geometry truncation, prototype replacement or fidelity reduction. Timeouts/caps retain failed case; unavailable GPU remains unavailable. Resource windows coordinated with fn13/fn18.

axis-order-v1.definition: All tree nodes as fn9: parent-before-child; root axis order 0; at each parent greatest child start_radius continues axis, exact tie lowest node index; other child starts axis of parent order+1. Degree-two chains are runs. Include root separately, lateral origins once. Ties flag ambiguous-dominant on affected descendant axes; retain raw counts but exclude flagged axes from qualified distributions.

axis-length-v1.definition: Sum parent-child Euclidean edge lengths on operational axis; exclude length <=1e-9. Publish per-axis and by-order count,min,max,median,p10,p90; quantiles nearest-rank ceil(p*n)-1, median average middle pair.

axis-diameter-v1.definition: Circular centreline proxy: diameter 2*start_radius at axis origin plus arc-length-weighted mean of linear edge diameter from child.start_radius to child.radius; publish by order. Not actual mesh collar diameter.

axis-taper-v1.definition: Interpolate linear edge diameters at axis arc fractions .1 and .9; publish proximal_m,distal_m,ratio=distal/proximal and slope_m_per_m=(proximal-distal)/(.8*length). Exact node fraction uses outgoing edge except final endpoint. Nonpositive proximal or zero length unavailable; ambiguity excluded.

axis-angle-v1.definition: At each lateral origin use incoming parent edge oriented away from root and first child edge oriented away from origin; acos(clamp(dot(unit vectors),-1,1))*180/pi. Root origins or either edge length <=1e-9 unavailable. Curved axes use these local tangents, not endpoint chord.

foliage-bins-v1.definition: One centroid per retained biological unit: arithmetic mean of unique prototype vertices in its biological subset, excluding petiole/peg; transform with original instance matrix. Needles count singly. Generic/unknown biological subset unavailable. Crown ymin/ymax from retained biological vertices; normalize centroid height (y-ymin)/(ymax-ymin), radial distance hypot(x-root.x,z-root.z)/max retained centroid radial distance. Zero spans unavailable. Report 4x4 counts, marginals, total, under/overflow, and occupied-bin support. No leaf-area inference. Each run reports its bounds; normalization is descriptive, never a shape-preservation score.
foliage-bins-v1.bin_rule: left-inclusive right-exclusive; last includes 1; out-of-range not clamped

projected-gaps-v1.definition: See PROTOCOL.md Crown masks; baseline-frozen convex crown ROI, linear coverage threshold, exterior openings separated from enclosed holes; no three-dimensional void/leaf-area meaning.

claim_policy: Collection completion, rendering convergence, visual inspection and independent botanical judgment are separate. No source-backed distribution gates or superiority claim. All missing/failing cases survive comparisons.
